source: Every entry below was read off the official Hikvision datasheet PDF named in its datasheetUrl. Fields the datasheet does not state are null, never inferred. priceTier is editorial (series positioning, not price data) and is flagged as such in the UI.

cameras.marketingName: 2 MP Fixed Bullet Network Camera
cameras.requiredBracket: Optional accessories named on the datasheet: DS-1275ZJ-SUS vertical pole mount, DS-1276ZJ-SUS corner mount, DS-1280ZJ-XS junction box.
headlineFeatures: EXIR 2.0 advanced infrared with long IR range
cameras.notes: Entry-level Value Series. Datasheet states Digital WDR only (no dB figure) and publishes no DORI distances. No microSD slot, no analytics beyond basic motion detection.

cameras.marketingName: 2 MP Fixed Dome Network Camera
cameras.requiredBracket: Optional accessories named on the datasheet: DS-1272ZJ-110 / DS-1258ZJ wall mount, DS-1271ZJ-110 pendant mount, DS-1275ZJ-SUS pole mount, DS-1276ZJ-SUS corner mount, DS-1259ZJ inclined ceiling mount, DS-1280ZJ-DM18 junction box.
headlineFeatures: EXIR 2.0 advanced infrared with long IR range
cameras.notes: Entry-level Value Series dome. Digital WDR only (no dB figure published), no DORI distances published, no microSD slot, no deep-learning analytics.

cameras.marketingName: 2 MP MD 2.0 Fixed Dome Network Camera
cameras.requiredBracket: Optional accessories named on the datasheet: DS-1272ZJ-110 / DS-1258ZJ wall mount, DS-1271ZJ-110 pendant mount, DS-1275ZJ-SUS pole mount, DS-1276ZJ-SUS corner mount, DS-1259ZJ inclined ceiling mount, DS-1280ZJ-DM18 junction box.
headlineFeatures: Motion Detection 2.0 — human and vehicle detection
EXIR 2.0 advanced infrared with long IR range
cameras.notes: MD 2.0 gives human/vehicle motion filtering but not the full AcuSense perimeter-protection rule set. Digital WDR only — no dB figure published.

cameras.marketingName: 2 MP Smart Hybrid Light Fixed Dome Network Camera
cameras.requiredBracket: Optional accessories named on the datasheet: DS-1272ZJ-120 / DS-220AZJ-130-WA wall mount, DS-1271ZJ-120 pendant mount, DS-1275ZJ-SUS pole mount, DS-1276ZJ-SUS corner mount, DS-4221ZJ-WC in-ceiling mount, DS-1280ZJ-DM46 junction box.
headlineFeatures: Smart Hybrid Light — IR plus white light
cameras.notes: Smart Hybrid Light gives colour at night with white light, but on an F1.6 lens and a 2 MP 1/2.9" sensor — not a ColorVu substitute. microSD slot is on the -F variant per the datasheet. IK08, not IK10. Digital WDR only.

cameras.marketingName: 2 MP Smart Hybrid Light 3.0 Fixed Dome Network Camera
cameras.requiredBracket: Optional accessories named on the datasheet: DS-1272ZJ-120 / DS-220AZJ-130-WA wall mount, DS-1271ZJ-120 pendant mount, DS-1275ZJ-SUS pole mount, DS-1276ZJ-SUS corner mount, DS-4221ZJ-WC in-ceiling mount, DS-1280ZJ-DM46 junction box.
onvifProfiles: ONVIF (profiles not itemised on the datasheet)
headlineFeatures: HikAI-ISP noise reduction and colour correction
Motion Detection 3.0 — more accurate person and vehicle detection
Smart Hybrid Light with 3 supplemental lighting modes
cameras.notes: Datasheet explicitly states on-board storage NA, audio NA, alarm NA and no perimeter protection or face capture. No IK rating published. Digital WDR only.

cameras.marketingName: 4 MP Smart Hybrid Light Fixed Dome Network Camera
cameras.requiredBracket: Optional accessories named on the datasheet: DS-1272ZJ-120 / DS-1272ZJ-120B wall mount, DS-1271ZJ-120 pendant mount, DS-1275ZJ-SUS pole mount, DS-1280ZJ-DM46 junction box.
headlineFeatures: Smart Hybrid Light — IR plus white light
cameras.notes: Datasheet caps the main stream at 20 fps at 2560x1440 — the bitrate figures the tool shows at 25/30 fps are therefore not achievable at full resolution on this model. microSD slot is on the -F variant. IK08, not IK10.

cameras.marketingName: 2 MP AcuSense Fixed Dome Network Camera
headlineFeatures: AcuSense human and vehicle target classification
cameras.notes: Audio and alarm I/O are on the -S variant only, per the datasheet. The counts recorded here are the -S figures.

cameras.marketingName: 4 MP AcuSense Fixed Dome Network Camera
headlineFeatures: AcuSense human and vehicle target classification
cameras.notes: The black-finish variant. Audio and alarm I/O on the -S model only; counts shown are the -S figures. Operating temperature range and body material are not stated on this datasheet revision.

cameras.marketingName: 4 MP AcuSense Built-in Mic Fixed Dome Network Camera
headlineFeatures: AcuSense human and vehicle target classification
Line crossing, intrusion and face detection
cameras.notes: The workhorse 4 MP AcuSense dome with a microphone. Datasheet lists no alarm or line-level audio I/O on this variant.

cameras.marketingName: 4 MP AcuSense Smart Hybrid Light Fixed Dome Network Camera
headlineFeatures: Smart Hybrid Light — IR plus white light, 4 lighting modes
cameras.notes: Alarm and line-level audio I/O are on the -S variant; the arrayed dual microphone is on the -2U variant. Counts shown are the fully-populated -S/-2U figures.

cameras.marketingName: 4 MP AcuSense Smart Hybrid Light Fixed Dome Network Camera
headlineFeatures: Smart Hybrid Light — IR plus white light, 4 lighting modes
cameras.notes: The -S / -2U variant of the DS-2CD2143G2-LI family: alarm and line-level audio I/O plus an arrayed dual microphone. This datasheet revision states a 1/2.9" sensor where the plain -LI revision states 1/3".

cameras.marketingName: 4 MP AcuSense Smart Hybrid Light Fixed Bullet Network Camera
headlineFeatures: Smart Hybrid Light — IR plus white light, 4 lighting modes
6 mm lens option reaches 25 m for recognition
cameras.notes: The 6 mm option is the useful one for a gate or driveway: the datasheet quotes D 128 m / O 50 m / R 25 m / I 12 m at 6 mm. Bullet body, so no IK rating is published.

cameras.marketingName: 4 MP AcuSense Smart Hybrid Light Fixed Bullet Network Camera
headlineFeatures: Smart Hybrid Light — IR plus white light, 4 lighting modes
cameras.notes: The -2U variant adds an arrayed dual microphone. This datasheet revision states a 1/2.9" sensor where the plain -LI revision states 1/3". 6 mm option quotes D 128 m / O 50 m / R 25 m / I 12 m.

cameras.marketingName: 4 MP AcuSense Powered-by-DarkFighter Fixed Bullet Network Camera
cameras.notes: Long-body bullet with a sunshield; the datasheet notes the body is metal except for the sunshield. The sibling -4I model has an 80 m IR range and draws up to 12 W over PoE. 6 mm option quotes D 120 m / O 47.6 m / R 24 m / I 12 m.

cameras.marketingName: 8 MP AcuSense Powered-by-DarkFighter Fixed Mini Bullet Network Camera
headlineFeatures: Face capture and full perimeter protection
cameras.notes: Very compact 4K bullet. Only 40 m of IR for an 8 MP sensor, so at night the far half of a long scene will be under-lit. Weight and operating temperature are not stated on this datasheet revision.

cameras.marketingName: 8 MP Powered-by-DarkFighter Fixed Mini Bullet Network Camera
headlineFeatures: 8 MP / 4K on a 1/1.8" sensor with an F1.0 lens
cameras.notes: The F1.0 "H" revision of the 8 MP mini bullet — roughly four times the light-gathering of the F1.6 DS-2CD2086G2-I at the same resolution. The DS-2CD2086G2H-I is the same camera without the microphone.

cameras.marketingName: 8 MP AcuSense Smart Hybrid Light Fixed Bullet Network Camera
headlineFeatures: 8 MP / 4K with Smart Hybrid Light to 60 m
6 mm option reaches 35 m for recognition
cameras.notes: 8 MP with colour-at-night white light and 60 m reach on an 802.3af budget — the best bandwidth-per-watt option in this set for a long outdoor run. The -4LI variants reach 80 m and draw up to 12 W. 6 mm option quotes D 176 m / O 70 m / R 35 m / I 17 m.

cameras.marketingName: 8 MP Powered-by-DarkFighter Strobe Light and Audible Warning Fixed Bullet Network Camera
headlineFeatures: Active strobe light and 120 dB siren to warn intruders off
Two built-in microphones and a speaker for two-way audio
cameras.notes: The deterrent model: strobe plus a 120 dB siren at 10 cm. Needs an 802.3at (PoE+) port — it will not run on an 802.3af switch.

cameras.marketingName: 2 MP AcuSense Motorised Varifocal Bullet Network Camera
headlineFeatures: Motorised 2.8–12 mm lens — set the field of view from the browser
cameras.notes: Only 2 MP, so the motorised zoom is doing the work rather than the sensor. microSD capped at 256 GB on this model, unlike most of the range. Datasheet publishes DORI as a table we could not parse reliably, so DORI distances are recorded as unavailable rather than guessed.

cameras.marketingName: 4 MP AcuSense Motorised Varifocal Bullet Network Camera
cameras.notes: F1.0 across the whole 2.8–12 mm range is unusual and is what makes this the strongest low-light varifocal here. Needs 802.3at. DORI distances are published as a table we could not parse reliably, so they are recorded as unavailable.

cameras.marketingName: 8 MP AcuSense Powered-by-DarkFighter Motorised Varifocal Bullet Network Camera
headlineFeatures: 8 MP / 4K with a motorised 2.8–12 mm lens
Alarm and audio I/O with audible warning linkage
cameras.notes: The highest-resolution varifocal in this set: 4K plus a motorised lens, which is the combination you want when the commissioning distance is uncertain. IP66 rather than IP67. DORI distances published as an unparsed table, so recorded as unavailable.

cameras.marketingName: 4 MP AcuSense Powered-by-DarkFighter Motorised Varifocal Dome Network Camera
headlineFeatures: Motorised 2.8–12 mm lens in a vandal-resistant dome
cameras.notes: A varifocal dome that still runs on 802.3af — useful when the existing switch has no PoE+ headroom. Only 40 m of IR because the illuminator has to fit inside the dome. DORI published as an unparsed table.

cameras.marketingName: 4 MP AcuSense Powered-by-DarkFighter Motorised Varifocal Turret Network Camera
headlineFeatures: Motorised 2.8–12 mm lens in a turret body
cameras.notes: Turret form factor avoids the dome bubble, so it does not suffer IR flare off the acrylic the way the DS-2CD2746G2-IZS can. Alarm output rated 500 mA rather than the usual 1 A. DORI published as an unparsed table.

cameras.marketingName: 4 MP ColorVu Strobe Light and Audible Warning Fixed Turret Network Camera
headlineFeatures: ColorVu — full-colour images at night, F1.0 lens on a 1/1.8" sensor
0.0005 lux colour sensitivity, 0 lux with white light
Active strobe light and audible warning
cameras.notes: White light only — there is no IR, so if the white light is switched off at night the camera is blind. Datasheet states Alarm NA for this variant. No IK rating published.

cameras.marketingName: 4 MP Smart Hybrid Light with ColorVu Fixed Turret Network Camera
headlineFeatures: Smart Hybrid Light — IR for covert mono, white light for colour, switchable
ColorVu F1.0 optics on a 1/1.8" sensor
Face capture and full perimeter protection
cameras.notes: The pragmatic choice over pure ColorVu: it keeps IR, so the client can run mono-covert at night and switch to colour only on an event. Draws only 6 W over PoE. No IK rating published.

cameras.marketingName: 4 MP Smart Hybrid Light Fixed Turret Network Camera
headlineFeatures: 0.0001 lux colour sensitivity — the most light-sensitive model in this set
cameras.notes: The -Y suffix carries a NEMA 4X anti-corrosion rating, which is the one to quote for coastal or washdown sites. 11 W over PoE is near the top of an 802.3af budget — check the switch.

cameras.marketingName: 8 MP Smart Hybrid Light Fixed Turret Network Camera
headlineFeatures: F1.0 optics on a 1/1.8" sensor, 0.0005 lux colour
cameras.notes: The highest pixel density available here in a fixed turret. The 30 m light range is the limit, not the sensor: beyond that at night you are relying on ambient light.

cameras.marketingName: 4 MP ColorVu Strobe Light and Audible Warning Fixed Mini Bullet Network Camera
headlineFeatures: ColorVu — 24/7 colour, F1.0 on a 1/1.8" sensor
Active strobe light and audio alarm to warn intruders off
cameras.notes: White light only, no IR. The 6 mm option reaches R 23.1 m / I 11.6 m, which is the one to use for a driveway. Datasheet states Alarm NA. Minimum focus distance at 6 mm is 12.1 m, so do not use the long lens for close work.

cameras.marketingName: 4 MP Smart Hybrid Light with ColorVu Fixed Mini Bullet Network Camera
headlineFeatures: Smart Hybrid Light — IR or white light, 40 m either way
Face capture and full perimeter protection
cameras.notes: Best all-round outdoor bullet in this set: colour at night when wanted, IR when covert, 40 m of both, and a 7 W draw. No IK rating and no alarm I/O.

cameras.marketingName: 4 MP ColorVu Fixed Bullet Network Camera
headlineFeatures: ColorVu with a 60 m white-light range — the longest colour-at-night reach here
F1.0 on a 1/1.8" sensor, 0.0005 lux colour
cameras.notes: The long-body ColorVu bullet: 60 m of white light where the mini bullets manage 40 m. White light only, no IR. The datasheet prints "I: 2 m" for the 2.8 mm identify distance, which is inconsistent with its own D/O/R figures, so that one value is recorded as unavailable rather than reproduced. Max PoE draw is not stated separately from the 12 VDC figure.

cameras.marketingName: 4 MP Smart Hybrid Light Strobe and Audible Warning Fixed Bullet Network Camera
headlineFeatures: Smart Hybrid Light 3.0 with 60 m reach on both IR and white light
cameras.notes: The most capable fixed 4 MP outdoor camera in this set: 60 m colour or covert IR, deterrent strobe and siren, two alarm pairs and a NEMA 4X housing. Needs 802.3at.

cameras.marketingName: 4 MP Panoramic ColorVu Strobe Light and Audible Warning Fixed Bullet Network Camera
cameras.sensorDescription: 2 x 1/2.5" Progressive Scan CMOS (dual-lens stitched panorama)
headlineFeatures: 180° panorama from two stitched lenses — one camera instead of two
cameras.notes: A 180° panorama spreads 3040 px across the whole width, so pixel density falls off fast — identify distance is only 3.5 m. Use it for wide situational awareness, not for faces. Note the stitched output is 3040x1368, not 4 MP in a 16:9 frame.

cameras.marketingName: 8 MP Panoramic Smart Hybrid Light Fixed Turret Network Camera
headlineFeatures: 182.6° horizontal field of view at 4256 x 1888
cameras.notes: The datasheet quotes a 182.6° horizontal FOV, which is beyond what a rectilinear lens model can represent; the optics maths here clamps it to 179.9° and the pixel-density figure for this model should be read as indicative only. Needs 802.3at and 24 W.

cameras.marketingName: 8 MP Smart Hybrid Light Varifocal Bullet Network Camera
headlineFeatures: 8 MP / 4K with a motorised 2.8–12 mm F1.2 lens
Smart Hybrid Light 3.0 — IR or white light, 60 m either way
Identify-grade to 22 m at the tele end per the datasheet
Strobe plus a 120 dB siren, two-way audio
cameras.notes: The strongest all-rounder in this set and usually the answer when a long distance has to be covered in colour: 4K, a motorised lens, 60 m of either IR or white light, deterrent strobe and siren, and NEMA 4X. At the tele end the datasheet quotes D 220 m / O 87.3 m / R 44 m / I 22 m. Needs 802.3at and 18 W.

cameras.marketingName: 4 MP 25x Powered-by-DarkFighter IR AcuSense Network Speed Dome
headlineFeatures: Active strobe light and audio alarm
Arrayed dual microphone and built-in speaker
cameras.notes: A PTZ only earns its place where someone is watching or where a guard tour is wanted — it cannot record everywhere at once. Datasheet gives 12 VDC max 18 W (including 1.6 W heater and 9 W IR) and states PoE 802.3at without a separate PoE wattage figure. Horizontal FOV at the two ends of the zoom range is published as a table we could not parse reliably, so lens FOV is recorded as unavailable and the optics maths falls back to the sensor-format calculation.

cameras.marketingName: 4 MP 25x Network IR Speed Dome
headlineFeatures: TVS 6000 V lightning and surge protection
cameras.notes: The earlier revision of the 4 MP 25x speed dome: IP66 rather than IP67 and no strobe, siren or built-in audio. Datasheet gives 12 VDC max 18 W (1.6 W heater, 9 W IR) and no separate PoE wattage. Lens FOV table not reliably parsable, so recorded as unavailable.

cameras.marketingName: 4 MP DeepinView ANPR IR Varifocal Bullet Network Camera
headlineFeatures: ANPR / licence-plate recognition, >=98% recognition rate per the datasheet
140 dB WDR — the highest here, which is what a gate with headlights needs
Two lens options: 2.8–12 mm or 8–32 mm
Parking-space status detection and timeout alarms
RS-485 and Wiegand output for barrier integration (-Y)
cameras.notes: The proper ANPR camera: 140 dB WDR, a dedicated plate-recognition engine and Wiegand output on the -Y variant for driving a barrier. The 8–32 mm option quotes D 400 m / O 158.7 m / R 80 m. The identify distance for the 2.8–12 mm option was not legible on the datasheet, so it is recorded as unavailable. The -Y variant also carries a NEMA 4X anti-corrosion rating.

cameras.marketingName: 4 MP ANPR Motorised Varifocal Bullet Network Camera
headlineFeatures: ANPR with blocklist and allowlist plate categorisation
60 m IR, dropping to 8 m in road-traffic mode
Wiegand output (26 bit and 34 bit) for barrier integration
cameras.notes: The mid-range ANPR option: cheaper than the DeepinView model but 120 dB WDR rather than 140 dB and a smaller 1/2.7" sensor, which matters at a gate at night. Note the datasheet states the IR range drops to 8 m in road-traffic mode — that is the shutter being held short to freeze a plate, not a fault.
